audience: HR teams that use ZenHR for branches, employees, time off and attendance

useCases.title: Find employees by branch and department
useCases.text: List the branches, then the departments and employees of one branch. Open one employee record.

useCases.title: Review time-off types and entries
useCases.text: List the time-off types of a branch. List the time-off entries of the branch or of one employee.

useCases.title: Review attendance records for a period
useCases.text: List the branches to find a branch id. Then list its clock-in and clock-out records between two dates.

useCases.title: Read the current job record of an employee
useCases.text: Read the job record active now for one employee, with position, department, site, manager and effective dates.

useCases.title: Check the connection and its scopes
useCases.text: Read the identity and scopes of the connection. Read the company of the ZenHR instance.
